question: Press reads at a second width: do Pricing Plan, Product and Audio rows follow their content at a narrower block?
how: Run f72 on the oracle: per block, Exit Without Saving, Edit on Blocks Probe, a blank section, Add Block and the block by name, then its east handle dragged left by half the add width (an unnamed press: done only after a check that the handle is on top at its centre, cursor col-resize), then Edit and the same switch presses as CAP-T12PRESS-A.json and -D.json, the block read before and after each. Left by Exit Without Saving; the page read 0 blocks at the end.
